role: Main-actor singleton that owns CloudKit session sync state, account-change handling, the direct per-recording upload path, forwarders to the pull/deletion/scrub/trash-restore coordinators, and the full-sync orchestration with stuck-sync recovery and no-progress watchdog.
types: CloudKitSyncManager: class (@Observable @MainActor final) — CloudKit HRV session sync manager singleton
CloudKitSyncManager.SyncState: enum — idle / syncing / error(String) shown by the sync status UI
state: mem:CloudKitSyncManager.lastPermanentErrorMessage (message behind a stopped sync; read by flagSchemaUnavailable/resumeSyncForAvailableAccount, no UI reads it)
mem:CloudKitSyncManager.fullSyncsAdmitted (@ObservationIgnored Int: full syncs admitted and not finished)
toplevel: static let shared = CloudKitSyncManager() builds the singleton lazily with defaults from AppDependencies.current (settingsManager, sessionArchive). Stored initializers: syncState .idle, schemaUnavailable false, lastSyncProgressAt .distantPast, pullVersion 0, container CKContainer(identifier: AppConfig.iCloudContainerIdentifier), recordType "HRVSession", zoneID HRVSessions/current user, syncSerializer SyncSerializer(), observers NotificationTokens(), didBootSyncState lock(false). liveBackup is a lazy CloudKitLiveBackupManager whose ensureZone closure calls ensureZoneExists on the manager. fullSyncsAdmitted starts at 0. No deinit: the private-init singleton is never released, so the observer token in `observers` is kept for the process.

flags.text: Quarantine is documented as surfaced to the user and reversible (quarantinedCount, quarantinedSessionIds, retryQuarantined), but no code in the repo (app or tests) reads quarantinedCount/quarantinedSessionIds or calls retryQuarantined. A session quarantined by handlePrepFailure is excluded from every push forever and the user is never told it is not backed up.

units.does: If a sync body is running (syncingStartedAt set) and neither its start nor its last progress (lastSyncProgressAt) is within 120 s, clears syncingStartedAt, sets syncState .error('Previous sync timed out — retrying') and returns true; otherwise false. A slow sync that keeps progressing is never declared stuck.
